title: UV-mapped models and a 128px texture standard
summary: Add a repeatable model-to-UV-to-texture workflow with a GoldSrc-inspired 128px texture limit.
notes: Document a hard 128x128 maximum for model and world textures in the project guidance.
Build the garage service cabinet with named UV islands, consistent texel density and padded edges.
Generate and apply a 128px painted cabinet atlas, export a GLB, and add checker and textured model previews.
Validate UVs, collision footprint, texture padding and runtime texture dimensions.
